title: Observability & Troubleshooting
summary: A systematic way to debug anything in Kubernetes, what every pod status really means, kubectl debug, and the metrics, logs, traces and alerts stack (metrics-server, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry) you need in production.
objectives: Apply a repeatable troubleshooting flow: get, describe, events, logs, exec/debug
Map pod statuses (Pending, ImagePullBackOff, CrashLoopBackOff, CreateContainerConfigError, OOMKilled, Evicted, stuck Terminating) to their usual causes and fixes
Work through a 'Service not reachable' checklist from DNS to endpoints to NetworkPolicy
Use kubectl debug for ephemeral containers, pod copies and node debugging
Explain the metrics pipeline (metrics-server vs Prometheus) and install kube-prometheus-stack
Describe a production logging and tracing setup (stdout, Fluent Bit/Alloy, Loki, OpenTelemetry)
Write a basic PrometheusRule alert and know what makes alerts useful
